final: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_women FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id FROM disp AS d JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN district AS dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND dist.A11 > 10000) AS eligible JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = eligible.client_id
